claim: Try it with sample data opens a populated sample glossary without changing real browser data.
sandbox: Fresh browser context; click the landing action; verify four sample cards, transformed reading output, and separate demo storage.

claim: Reset demo restores the shipped sample after a sample change.
sandbox: Fresh demo; remove ngrok; reset; verify it is restored.

claim: A saved spoken form can be previewed with the browser speech API.
sandbox: Fresh demo with a recorded browser speech fixture; preview Kubernetes and inspect the spoken value.

claim: Saved aliases change matching selected text without changing parts of other words.
sandbox: Shipped cards and a technical sentence; assert overlapping, case-insensitive, punctuation, and inside-word outcomes.

claim: A sample card can produce copyable SSML.
sandbox: Fresh demo with a clipboard fixture; copy Kubernetes SSML and inspect the result.

claim: A glossary can be exported as readable JSON.
sandbox: Fresh demo; export the sample and parse the downloaded JSON.

claim: The website and sample use no cookies or third-party requests; the sample uses a separate browser-storage key.
sandbox: Fresh landing and demo; record every request and inspect storage and cookies after reading the sample.

claim: The demo reloads offline after its first visit.
sandbox: Dedicated browser context; visit /demo, wait for the service worker, set offline, and reload.

claim: The packaged extension saves a pronunciation card in browser extension storage without a network request during the card flow.
sandbox: Launch the built MV3 package in a fresh Chromium profile; save Docker, inspect extension storage, and record requests.

claim: The packaged extension can merge imported JSON or replace its glossary.
sandbox: Launch the built MV3 package in a fresh Chromium profile; merge two cards, then replace them with an empty glossary.

claim: The packaged extension has no persistent all-sites host permission.
sandbox: Inspect the manifest in the built MV3 package and verify its action-scoped permissions and empty host permissions.

claim: The extension ZIP is available without an account.
where: Landing first screen and install section; README
sandbox: Fresh request context; download the linked ZIP and verify its ZIP signature, type, and minimum package size.
